title: Wine Tasting Note Score Leaderboard
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wine:tasting score=*
| stats sum(score) as total_value, avg(score) as avg_value by tasting_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tasting type values by total and average score across wine tasting note events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score` values for each wine tasting note event and review total and average score by tasting type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total score.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which tasting type shows the biggest score numbers in your wine tasting note data.
